commits: 949163f3 S4B-6: run folder name carries the process id (two starts in the same second shared one folder in the local dry-run test)
c02ce694 S4B-6: cloud resource estimate from the S4B-5 smoke and the cloud package for the S4B main settings (prepared only, no cloud action)

f3ff1e9a S4B-5: builds and 56x3h Gurobi smoke with all S4B main settings (integrated OPTIMAL, disconnected main NUMERIC as expected, disconnected gap diagnostic OPTIMAL, optional integrated diagnostic SUBOPTIMAL); KKT diagnostic of the integrated gate failures
7141868d S4B-5 prep: gap-diagnostic builds also write the 365x24h daily network (cloud diagnostic run, S4B-6); S4B-5 smoke summary script; progress file
1c48eb04 S4B-4: typhoon exposure from IBTrACS and the typhoon_premium sensitivity switch (decision 76); ship-density checksum and protected-area check
5ed1da4a S4B-3: onshore-wind calibration on observed generation and the DEA 2050 turbine (decision 74), three resource classes in the main run (decision 75)
2d9e2f09 S4B-2: caps for geothermal, new hydro and new PHS candidates (decision 78), nuclear national-plan cap switch (decision 79)
31da24c8 S4B-1: existing-stock rules for 2050 (decision 77) - construction counted incl. units without a start year, GIPT-2026 non-operating units removed

c3472937 S4B-0 smoke: builds and 56x3h Gurobi smoke with decisions 70-73 (integrated OPTIMAL, disconnected main NUMERIC as expected, disconnected gap diagnostic OPTIMAL); structural gaps; acceptance re-evaluation of S3B / S4A
3afb044d S4B-0: decisions 70-73 (sector switches aligned with PyPSA-Eur incl. methanation, solver-tolerance acceptance, LNG expansion at cost, gas slack in the gap diagnostic)
label: SMOKE_TEST_ONLY results have no scientific meaning before the cloud run (decision 47)
